newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 19.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 19.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The state may void the privatisation contract of the Szekszard meat processing company if the German owner have not met the agreed conditions.
- The government and agricultural producers could not reach an agreement about changes in 1997 VAT and personal income tax regulations.

- Marta Tocsik, key figure of a privatisation scandal, attended a hearing by a parliamentary committee investigating real estate affairs of opposition parties, but she did not go to a hearing by the committee investigating the privatisation scandal.
- The Hungarian and the Polish foreign ministers welcome in a joint statement what the U.S. Foreign Department said about the prospects of NATO-enlargement on Tuesday.
